lines.zh: 一跳一跳，岩浆在地上留个印。
lines.en: Bounce by bounce, my heat marks the floor.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲的路，烫得刚好。
lines.en: The basalt delta road is hot just right.

lines.zh: 我滚过下界荒地，石头都软了。
lines.en: I roll through the wastes and the stone softens.

lines.zh: 一步一团火，别踩我后面。
lines.en: A puff of fire each step, don't walk behind me.
One hop, and the ash flies up.

lines.zh: 我这身岩浆，走到哪都发光。
lines.en: This lava skin of mine glows wherever I go.
Out of the way, I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 每跳一下，身子就晃一晃。
lines.en: Every hop, my whole body wobbles.
The lava gurgles under my skin.
The ground smokes where I press it.

lines.zh: 慢慢蹦，反正下界不着急。
lines.en: Slow hops, the Nether is in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我的脚印一会儿就烧没了。
lines.en: My footprints burn away in a moment.

lines.zh: 跳过熔岩池，像回家一样。
lines.en: Hopping the lava pools feels like going home.
One bounce flicks off a few sparks.

lines.zh: 我撞到墙也不停，弹回来再跳。
lines.en: I hit a wall, rebound, and hop again.

lines.zh: 熔岩在我脚下翻了个泡。
lines.en: The lava bubbles under my feet.
Gurgle, gurgle, I am thinking things over.
This crust of mine hardens when it cools.
Who stirred my lava so smooth?

lines.zh: 我听见自己的泡泡在响。
lines.en: I hear my own bubbles popping.

lines.zh: 下界没有白天，我也不睡。
lines.en: No daylight down here, and I never sleep.
The heat feels a little low today.

lines.zh: 我身上的泡泡，一个接一个破。
lines.en: My bubbles pop one after another.

lines.zh: 静下来就觉得自己在煮。
lines.en: When I am still, I feel myself boiling.
The stone is warm, I will sit a while.
I am not cold, I have never been cold.
Something is turning over in my belly.
Let me wobble myself perfectly even.
Your skin looks like it burns well.

lines.zh: 站住，让我看看你怕不怕烫。
lines.en: Stand still, let me see if you fear heat.

lines.zh: 你身上没有火，怪可怜的。
lines.en: No fire in you at all, poor thing.

lines.zh: 你是不是从上面掉下来的？
lines.en: Did you fall down from up there?
I have my eye on you, do not blink.
Your shadow flickers across my body.
Another one come to the Nether to die.
I am counting how long before you run.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，闻着有点甜。
lines.en: That thing in your hand smells faintly sweet.
Not too close, I splash easily.
Sss, you dare touch me?
It hurts so much that I smoke.
I lost a piece of myself.
Who hit me with something cold?
That one cooled half of me.
You burst one of my bubbles.
You scattered a bit of me.
My gurgling caught in my throat.
Stop, I am full of lava inside.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，又把身子撑圆。
lines.en: I shook, then rounded myself out again.
That flame there, let me taste it.
I know the smell of magma cream.
Hold fire and I will follow you.
Warm things, I want all of them.

lines.zh: 给我一点烫的，我就安静。
lines.en: Give me something hot and I will settle.
Those few sparks will feed me a while.

lines.zh: 别藏了，我闻到岩浆味了。
lines.en: Stop hiding it, I smell lava.

lines.zh: 你手里亮亮的，是给我留的吗？
lines.en: Something bright in your hand, is it for me?

lines.zh: 我追的不是你，是你那点火。
lines.en: I am not chasing you, I am chasing your fire.

lines.zh: 再靠近点，我舔一下就走。
lines.en: Come closer, one lick and I am done.

lines.zh: 撞上了，你身上冒烟了吧。
lines.en: We bumped, you are smoking now, right?

lines.zh: 让开，我这团东西不收脚。
lines.en: Move aside, this blob does not brake.
I bounced onto your leg, sorry about that.
One burn, remember to dodge next time.

lines.zh: 我不是故意压你的，是弹的。
lines.en: I did not mean to squash you, I bounced.
You were standing where I landed.

lines.zh: 撞这一下，我掉了几滴岩浆。
lines.en: That bump cost me a few drops of lava.
Do not push me, I will burst.

lines.zh: 我这身子太软，拐不了弯。
lines.en: This body is too soft to turn.
Bumped again, you stand too close.

lines.zh: 我滚过你脚背，算你运气好。
lines.en: I rolled over your foot, count yourself lucky.
I bounced back right into your arms.
You carry a scorch mark from me.

lines.zh: 让一让，我停不住这团火。
lines.en: Step aside, I cannot stop this fire.

lines.zh: 两块岩浆贴一起，就成一团。
lines.en: Two lumps of lava touch and become one.
Squeeze together and the fire burns brighter.
When we split, I shrink and you stay big.
Do not fear, even lava wants company.
Pressed together is warmer than any stone.

lines.zh: 等我们裂开，就是一家子。
lines.en: When we crack apart, we are a family.

lines.zh: 你的一半，我的一半，都是烫的。
lines.en: Your half, my half, both scalding.
I hop once, you hop once.

lines.zh: 合在一起，咕嘟声都整齐了。
lines.en: Together, our gurgling falls in rhythm.
I am wrapping around you, hold still.
This magma cream is mine now.

lines.zh: 我把它吞进去，肚子更热。
lines.en: Swallow it and my belly burns hotter.

lines.zh: 掉了块黑石，我捡起来垫脚。
lines.en: A blackstone chunk fell, I will stand on it.
Odd, this thing is not even hot.

lines.zh: 我吞了它，它在我里面化。
lines.en: I ate it and it melts inside me.

lines.zh: 地上亮的东西，我都收着。
lines.en: Anything glinting on the floor, I keep.
This coal will feed my fire nicely.
Leave it, I saw it first.

lines.zh: 我把它裹进身子里，慢慢化。
lines.en: I fold it into my body to melt slowly.

lines.zh: 我肚子里东西越来越多了。
lines.en: More and more things end up inside me.

lines.zh: 那边有活物，我听见心跳。
lines.en: Something lives over there, I hear a heartbeat.
The target is you, stop looking around.
I smell meat on the air.

lines.zh: 你站在我跳得到的地方。
lines.en: You stand within one hop of me.
Found you, hiding is useless.
In this Nether, you stand out most.
You are locked in, now run.
Your breathing is far too loud.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的火把了。
lines.en: I see the torch in your hand.

lines.zh: 从这边过去，正好压住你。
lines.en: This angle lets me land right on you.
Two more steps and I am there.
The more you run, the faster I bounce.
Do not hide near the lava.
I hear you panting.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚印烧过去。
lines.en: I burn along the trail of your prints.
Almost there, my fire arrives first.
Circle all you like, I am patient.
This lump of mine can catch you.
Hold still so I can hit squarely.
That smoke behind you is me.
Hot! That one you will remember.
I press down and you leap away.
Do not touch me, I am all fire.

lines.zh: 我撞你胸口，用整团身子。
lines.en: I hit your chest with my whole bulk.
This blow comes with lava in it.
Your armor will not stop heat.
I land and your health drops.
Taste the temperature of the Nether.
I hit without any claws.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我全部的重量。
lines.en: That was all of my weight.
I open my eyes inside the lava.
I roll out onto the basalt.
The Nether again, still this hot.
I squeezed my way out of the fire.

lines.zh: 谁在叫我？我刚开始冒泡。
lines.en: Who called me? I just started bubbling.
I land and the ground chars.
A fresh blob, and hungry too.
The Nether wastes have one more of me.
Here I am, covered in sparks.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，掉下几滴岩浆。
lines.en: I shake and a few drops of lava fall.
Fire? Fire is my home.
A fall just makes me bounce higher.
Water, water is pouring on me.
That blast scattered me everywhere.
Who is shooting at me from afar?

lines.zh: 这股凉气，钻进我身子里。
lines.en: That chill seeps into my body.
I am hungry, so my fire shrinks.
Lightning? The Nether has no lightning.
No bottom below, and I keep falling.
